bill.constitutionalAuthorityStatementText:
From the Congressional Record Online through the Government Publishing Office [www.gpo.gov]
By Mr. YOUNG of Alaska:
H.R. 517.
Congress has the power to enact this legislation pursuant
to the following:
The constitutional authority on which this bill rests is
the power of Congress to make rules for the government and
regulate commerce, as enumerated in Article 1, Section 8,
Clause 3 of the United States Constitution.
[Page H513]

bill.title: To amend the Federal Water Pollution Control Act to eliminate the authority of the Administrator of the Environmental Protection Agency to deny or restrict the use of a defined area as a dredged or fill material disposal site, and for other purposes.
